note: Golden-master baselines for the native UI port's parity checks. Captured from the web-rendered app via its Vite dev server (headless Chromium, ANGLE/SwiftShader, deviceScaleFactor 1). Pins: photrez.locale=en (stable strings) and photrez.bgFlagRoute=0 - the app's own documented rollback switch; without it the document-open path waits for a native seed that a browser cannot provide and refuses the open. Document recipe: blank canvas named "Baseline", 800x600. Capture conventions and the tolerance policy for comparisons: see README.md beside this manifest.
